events.description:

Note: If you are a person with a disability and wish to attend these meetings and require any accommodations to participate, please contact DECD at 717-849-2264. Persons with hearing impairments may contact the Deaf Center at TTD 717-848-6765.

events.title: Crispus Attucks York is proud to host the 4th Annual Veterans Stand Down
events.location: Horticultural Hall at York Expo Center, 334 Carlisle Avenue, York, PA, 17401, United States
events.description:
❤️🤍💙Crispus Attucks York is proud to host our 4th Annual Veterans Stand Down, a one-stop event dedicated to supporting Veterans who are homeless, at-risk, or transitioning in our community. Help us spread the word by sharing this post with the Veterans and military families in your network. Together, we can connect those who served with the resources they deserve. 
Join us for access to valuable resources and services, including: 
– VA Services
– Medical & Dental Services
– Housing
– Employment
– Food
– Clothing
– Hygiene Kits
– FREE Hot Lunch 
📅 Wednesday, September 23, 2026 
⏰ 11:00 AM – 2:00 PM 
📍 NEW LOCATION: Horticultural Hall at the York Expo Center 
334 Carlisle Avenue, York, PA 
Need transportation or more information? Contact: 
📞 Barry Freeland – (717) 781-0014 
📞 Jomo Beatty – (717) 542-0091 
#VeteransStandDown #CrispusAttucksYork #SupportOurVeterans #YorkPA #VeteranResources #GiveRiseToPossible #WeNotI #VeteransHelpingVeterans ❤️🤍💙

events.title: 2nd Annual Legacy Gala
events.location: County Club of York, 1400 Country Club Rd, York, PA, 17403
events.description:
Join Crispus Attucks York for our 2nd Annual Legacy Gala on Thursday, October 22, 2026, from 5:00 PM to 9:00 PM at the Country Club of York, as we proudly honor Rebecca and Frank Countess for their extraordinary commitment to our organization and the York community. 
Together, the Countess family has made community service a way of life. Their commitment to Crispus Attucks York spans multiple generations. The Legacy Gala will be an evening of celebration, fellowship, fine dining, and reflection as we honor Rebecca and Frank’s lasting impact while highlighting Crispus Attucks York’s 95-year legacy of empowering youth, strengthening families, and creating opportunities throughout our community. 
Theme: Molded by History. Changing Our Future. 
For sponsorship opportunities, please contact Donna Williams at 717-848-3612 or dwilliams@crispusattucks.org.
